item.title: 4,500 expat ballots returned over invalid addresses: EC
item.description: Nearly 4,500 postal ballots sent to expatriate voters have been returned because the addresses could not be traced, Election Commissioner Abul Fazal Md Sanaullah said on Thursday.Briefing reporters at the Election Commission office in Agargaon, he said most of the undelivered ballots were sent to Malaysia, followed by Italy, adding that there was nothing more the commission could do about them.So far, 767,084 postal ballots have been dispatched abroad. item.title: NIDCH expansion fails to ease service crunch
item.description: Despite physical expansion, the National Institute of Diseases of the Chest and Hospital (NIDCH) continues to fall short of patient expectations, hobbled by ageing infrastructure, chronic manpower shortages, outdated diagnostic facilities and entrenched irregularities.As Bangladesh's sole national referral centre for chest and respiratory diseases, NIDCH draws critically ill patients from Dhaka and distant districts alike. item.title: Over 100 dead in torrential rains, floods across southern Africa
item.description: Army helicopters rescued people stranded on rooftops and hundreds of tourists and workers were evacuated from one of the world's biggest game reserves, as torrential rains and flooding in three countries in southern Africa killed more than 100 people, authorities said Friday.The death toll across South Africa, Mozambique and Zimbabwe is an accumulation after weeks of heavy rains. item.title: Trump threatens tariffs as US lawmakers back Denmark, Greenland
item.description: Donald Trump on Friday warned that he could slap tariffs on countries that do not support his Greenland takeover plans, as US Congress members visited Copenhagen to give their backing for Denmark and its autonomous Arctic island.The bipartisan delegation, on a two-day trip to the Danish capital, said the US president's long-held territorial ambitions -- strongly rejected by Denmark -- were not shared by the American people.Europeans have also been showing their backing for Greenland, in a milita

item.title: Dramatic final over sees Rajshahi edge past Sylhet by 5 runs
item.description: In a nail-biting finish at the Sher-e-Bangla National Stadium, Rajshahi Warriors held their nerve to defeat Sylhet Titans by 5 runs in a dramatic encounter that saw the match swing wildly until the very last ball.Chasing a target of 148, Sylhet needed 11 runs off the final over bowled by Sri Lankan pacer Binura Fernando.The drama peaked when, after two wides and a series of tight deliveries, Sylhet needed 6 runs off the last ball. item.description: Nagorik Oikya President Mahmudur Rahman Manna has been hospitalised after experiencing chest pain.The party’s central committee member A. item.title: EU deploys 56 long-term observers to all 64 dists
item.description: The European Union Election Observation Mission (EU EOM) on Saturday deployed 56 long-term observers (LTOs) across all 64 districts of the country to monitor the upcoming national elections scheduled.The election observation mission began its work from this morning by departing from the capital Dhaka to various districts of the country.Speaking at a press briefing at a city hotel, the Deputy Chief Observer Inta Lase said, "The long-term observers are a critical element of our mission.
